note: v428: The Loan tab is now a full loan tracker. Save named loans to your account (synced), each with a month-by-month payment calendar, the amortization schedule, and a log of the actual payments you record — recorded payments track your true remaining balance and check off the schedule. Loan payment due dates also show on the Dashboard calendar and Upcoming list. NOTE: run the new `loans` table SQL (in CLAUDE.md) in Supabase before saving a loan.
